## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass

- [ ] `docs/architecture.md` updated if structure, interfaces or the data model changed
- [ ] `docs/ROADMAP.md` "Current status" and `CHANGELOG.md` updated

- [ ] No new GPL-licensed dependency
